verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents bulk import of existing users, organizations, memberships and roles from other sources such as Auth0, using the AuthKit API and a CLI migrations tool. However, nothing in the evidence shows password-hash import or any way to export users back out of WorkOS. A community member raises this lock-in question without an answer, which lowers confidence but is not concrete counter-evidence. Missing for 10: documented password-hash import, a documented user export path out of WorkOS, hands-on corroboration of the migration tooling.
